title: Rationale for Inability to Recover Overpayment Amount for Contract Variations in National Gallery Development Project
what_it_is: Rationale for Inability to Recover Overpayment Amount for Contract Variations in National Gallery Development Project

sections.label: MCCY review of NGS waivers
sections.summary: MCCY reviewed AGO's findings and is satisfied no fraud was involved in NGS' waivers of contractual provisions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MCCY has reviewed AGO's findings and is satisfied that there was no fraud involved in the National Gallery of Singapore's (NGS') waivers of contractual provisions.

sections.label: NGS $13 million waivers explained
sections.summary: MCCY says the $13 million was waivers of penalties and variation orders, not overpayment, and its final audit has resumed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The $13 million was not overpayment, but primarily waivers of penalties for additional time taken by the contractor to complete construction works.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MCCY's fifth and final audit has since resumed after being suspended due to the AGO audit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Arising from the AGO audit and MCCY's final audit, MCCY will work with NGS to enhance their financial processes and procurement policies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Would MCCY be recovering that $13 million penalty as well?

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: It is not a penalty; it is actually waivers and also for variation orders, which are to be expected for a project that is that massive, that involves two monuments and an extension connecting the two.

sections.label: Variation order approvals and audit
sections.summary: NGS adopted AGO's recommendations on variation order approvals, and MCCY sees no need for major recoveries.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Another part of these findings relates to the systems of approval of the variation orders.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: This part, NGS has fully adopted the recommendations of AGO, and MCCY would work with them to see that these are implemented.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Having said all that, we are going through a final audit and we have not completed the audit.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: But based on my understanding at this point in time and having gone through the AGO reports extensively and several times with NGS, we are satisfied that the claims or the variation orders have good basis and there is no reason for us to believe that there is any need for major recoveries.
